verdict.rationale: Recurring job scheduling is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows running Slurm batch jobs through SUNK and running workloads on managed Kubernetes (CKS); nothing documents a recurring or cron-style schedule for jobs or workflows. Running one-off batch jobs is not the same as recurring scheduling, and bucket lifecycle policies are an adjacent storage feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
